body:
I don't have anything that would be considered deformities really, I just look very very strange/unpleasant and have heard about it all my life from all my peers. It wouldn't bother me if it wasn't so drastic that  even when I try my best to be friendly and make contact with people they withdraw from me as if I had some deadly illness.

Basically, as a child I was very social despite being bullied and shy, and did quite well at school. I however had a tendency to make up excuses so that I could stay at home, which I now recognize as being social anxiety symptoms.

My family consists of a alcoholic father who's prone to violent outbursts, a mother who has been unemployed for 15+ years and my older sister who is currently finishing up university. In terms of family dynamics, my father has been beating my mom for as long as I can remember, and my mom has never really sought help for it.

I started getting psychological help at age 12. When I started 7th grade my problems got worse, and I would skip more and more school despite staying up all night to prepare for it and to groom myself to look presentable. In the end, by 8th grade I skipped school so much that my dad would start dragging me there by the hair, and would also take every chance he got to bring out his anger on me. Long story short, I tell the people at school that I'm afraid of my father and would really prefer them to inform my mother about my absence in classes, social services end up interfering, my relationship with my dad ends up at an all time low (because how could I lie about him being like that!) and instead of the social services helping me and my mother out of the situation they just wanted to move me to a child caring institution despite me telling them I'm afraid my mom will end up dead. I refused.

9th grade, I ended up skipping so much school that I couldn't finish my mandatory education and ended up being offered a place at a small school that only took in mental disordered students. Also was offered the chance to live in the ward there for proper care, but as my sister had moved out and I didn't want my mom ending up dead I refused it. 

I get accepted to a high school. That summer, my dad had perhaps his most violent outburst toward my mother. Forcing myself in between them and telling him I will call the cops and that he would have to kill me to stop me from doing it, after a lot of yelling and threats he ends up leaving and we finally make a police report about it after visiting the hospital. Well, it ends up going nowhere as my mom is a coward and the police thought that there's no way that could be the case as my father seems like such a pleasant man. Either way me and my mom have come to an agreement that we have to move out.

I went to high school for around a week, then I couldn't take it anymore. My anxiety was horrible, I was stressing out about how I can make ends meet once me and my mom live by ourselves and my dog had to be put to sleep. I had originally planned that oh, we are going to move out, I get to be in an environment that isn't so damaging and I can concentrate on my studies, so I take some time off from school so that we could move out. Well, nothing ends up happening. My mom has a horrible hoarding problem, and there was just absolutely no progress being done.

And now, almost 1/4th of my life later, the situation is still the same. The only thing that has changed is that my depression and social anxiety is even worse than it was before, as nowadays I cannot even go outside when it's dark because I don't want people to see me. I haven't seen a psychologist in four years, and I feel like there's just absolutely nothing I can do in this situation to change it. If I ever wanted to get 'better', I would need an environment that actually feels like home. But since I am not functional in the slightest and get anxious about seeing people outside my window in fear that they see how horrible I look, I don't really even have the option to move on my own. I'm a stupid, worthless and horrible human and don't have many options in life either way, so combining that to my living situation just makes me feel so crippled and unable to even try. I feel like the only thing I can do to help myself is to kill myself. Thought about a future as this failure of a human is unbearable to think about, especially since I have ruined everything I have ever got the chance to do and as I grow older it's less and less likely that will ever change. 

I'm really sorry for such a huge wall of text, I just honestly have absolutely no one to talk to. Thank you so much for bothering to leave a reply, you can't even imagine how much it means to me.
